d:
Years ago, I commissioned a Japanese->Spanish tl of this doujin that I could then turn into an English tl. It's the second and last such commission I'll ever do. I am still open to doing Spanish->Eng translations, so feel free to reach out to me about such.

Also, if any part of my tl of this doujin significantly contradicts the spirit of the original, feel free to leave feedback (and if you'd like to have a convo, best do it through PM). Your feedback might convince me to update this translation with your suggestions in the future.

Update: Noticed that one of the pages was missing its main text. Should be fixed now. Also, a Spanish release is in the works.
n: [Artist CG] [Yawaraka Taiyou] Loli Kyonyuu-chan to Hatsuiku Kensa (Zenpen) | Physical Exams for Busty Lolis (Vol. 1) [English] [AzureArtism]
